findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the filename is attacker-controlled, it could be used to inject a malicious command.
findings.assumptions: The HP_CreateFile function uses the filename to execute a command or create a file. The filename is derived from user input or another untrusted source.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If the name, surname, or city fields are too long (more than 14 characters), they could overflow the buffer and overwrite adjacent memory.
findings.assumptions: The Record structure is used to store user input or data from an untrusted source, and the fields are not validated for length.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the filename is attacker-controlled, it could be used to inject a malicious command.
findings.assumptions: The HP_OpenFile function uses the filename to execute a command or open a file. The filename is derived from user input or another untrusted source.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the file descriptor is obtained from an attacker-controlled source, it could be used to inject a malicious command.
findings.assumptions: The CHUNK_CreateIterator function uses the file descriptor to execute a command or create a chunk. The file descriptor is derived from user input or another untrusted source.
